reviews.text:
Zivel CryoLift Review
I had the CryoLift facial at Zivel, and I’m honestly blown away. The cooling part felt so soothing, and the whole treatment was incredibly relaxing. When I looked in the mirror afterward, my skin looked tighter, brighter, and way more awake. Even people at work noticed the glow. Zivel’s team made the experience feel personal and comfortable, and the results were better than I expected. If you want something that makes you look refreshed without any downtime, this is it. Cheri is AMAZING..!!

We’re in town visiting from Texas and had another wonderful experience at Zivel! This isn’t our first time visiting this location, and we always enjoy coming back.

This visit, we enjoyed the vibration plate, another great service and added benefit to your health and recovery. The facility is beautiful, clean, and welcoming, and the owners and staff are incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. It’s clear from the moment you walk in that they truly care about their clients and take pride in what they do.

We’ve had such a great experience every time and would highly recommend Zivel to anyone looking for a friendly, professional, and refreshing wellness experience! ❤️

I am so completely impressed with all the services available at such a great price. Compression therapy and float therapy are my go to treatments after workouts, traveling  or tiresome tasks. Today, after a longer than usual tread session, my lower back and hamstrings were TIGHT and painful. I immediately went for the compression therapy and Cheri and Stacie suggested I come back for a  cryo-soothing session for localized pain and inflammation later in the afternoon. By the time I returned, after compression , I was already experiencing relief. The cryo  session with Janya was incredible and relieved any lingering discomfort. If you are looking for recovery services with state of the art equipment and wonderful people, Zivel Bentonville is the place for you!

Amazing. I was a little hesitant at first because I didn’t know if this would be my kind of thing…but I am super glad I visited Zivel. I did the dry float, leg compressions and the oxygen bar. I felt terrific afterwards. The staff was extremely patient and took the time to walk me through everything. They were available throughout my entire experience but weren’t overbearing or pushy. Super affordable and excellent value for my money. I am gonna bring my wife next time and we are gonna try out the cryo chamber and the infrared sauna. Excited to come back.

I can always count on Zivel to deliver an optimal performance and recovery experience, while setting a clear standard in professionalism and customer service!!

Chad H.

Shout out to Joe, Cheri and the Zivel Bentonville crew for helping me fast-track an injury rehab in advance of the Bentonville half marathon. Beating my goal time by over 5 min would have never been possible without your amazing services and support...you guys are the absolute best!!!

Chad H.

I've lived in Belmont for years and have frequented various semi-similar businesses in the past, primarily in Charlotte, but this was my first time visiting Zivel. Such a great addition to our downtown. I generally love a good thermal circuit, but I had specific needs this time with a tweaked shoulder in advance of a golf tournament.

Zivel, its owner, and all staff were incredible. Gave me a great deal on whole body cryo, localized cryo, and compression therapy to help me prepare for the week ahead. The facilities are awesome and clean. The flexibility of walking in or seamlessly making appointments via the app make it easy.

I've spent a lot of time doing cryo, red light, compression, infrared sauna and float, but have never found such a great place so close to home. They even have an oxygen bar, or if you need a gift idea for the wife, buy her a cryo facial lift.

Highly recommend checking out if you're not familiar or if you've been curious. They'll take good care of you there.

Ashley is a great esthetician who provides a relaxing experience and really pays attention to your skin’s needs. She’s professional, gentle, and gives helpful skincare advice without being pushy. I always leave feeling refreshed and well cared for.
Ashley is an amazing esthetician with outstanding communication skills and very informative, shes super sweet and is soo good at making you feel comfortable and relaxed! I definitely recommend ASHLEY

Professional, knowledgeable, and attentive. Ashley created a relaxing experience and provided excellent care with great attention to detail. My skin felt refreshed and looked amazing afterward. Highly recommend!

I have been a member of Zivel Belmont for almost one year. I can't get over there enough. Cryo by far is the best and the staff is outstanding especially Sidney and and Crystal but I love coach as well. If you've never experienced this, you need to try it out. It's the most refreshing thing in the whole wide world. Very clean, very well located, and worth every penny.

Let’s start by saying I’m not a spa girl now that being said my experience with Zivel/Brecksville was nothing but good. Start to finish. I was greeted very warmingly and had the pleasure of meeting the owners and got a personal tour of the facility. Warm, clean, relaxing and very inviting. As for the facial it’s was amazing how much of a difference it made to my skin. The session itself was relaxing and it truly made my skin glow. I will be returning on a regular basis. Thanks so much.
My sister and I did a 45 minute red light sauna session and it was amazing! Beautiful facility and you have the room to yourself so you can enjoy the sauna and come in and out as you need to.

If you're suffering from painful muscles and joints or just need some de-stressing time, Zivel is the perfect place for both.  The Staff are personable and do not pressure you to sign up for any services or try anything you're not comfortable with. They make your experience fun and relaxing and their top priority is You the Customer and ensuring you are safe, comfortable and relaxed while you are at Zivel.  Always clean and able to work with my schedule.  Highly recommend Zivel in Brecksville for Cryotherapy, Infared Light Therapy, Sauna, Compression for legs & arms, oxygen bar, float room, and massage therapy.
Absolutely LOVED my experience here! I tried all 5 services included in the membership & enjoyed each one! I can’t wait to come back!

My boyfriend and I had such a great experience at Zivel! The offer so many difference services, and can’t wait to try them all. The place is very clean and the office manager was so kind, professional and helpful!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Amazing experience at Zivel Buckhead! I tried the red light therapy, infrared sauna, and compression therapy, and loved all three. The place is beautiful, super clean, relaxing, and perfect after a long workday or for a wellness day with a friend.

Special shoutout to Tia! She was incredibly friendly, caring, and made the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be back whenever I’m in the area. Highly recommend! ❤️

I wish will be a place like that on the south area!!

Clean facility and amazing hospitality! The team goes above and beyond and clearly explained the membership and all the services available. I also love that they have an app where you can easily check service availability before you go.
Overall, a great experience! Perfect for a self-care day or even a quick stop during a lunch break to relax in the red light therapy sauna or try the leg compression with the oxygen mask. I also had the chance to meet the owner, Tia, and her team member, Robin—both were very kind and welcoming. Highly recommend supporting this new business!

I had an amazing experience at Zivel Buckhead! The infrared sauna was incredible and exactly what I needed. The facility was spotless, well-maintained, and had a great setup that made the experience comfortable and relaxing from start to finish.
What made it even better was the team. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and took the time to help me get settled and make sure I was comfortable before my session.
I left feeling refreshed and recharged and will definitely be back. Highly recommend!!

My partner and I visited Zivel in Buckhead for my birthday while we were visiting Atlanta from out of town, and we had such a great experience! We purchased day passes and got to try the lymphatic compression, red light therapy, cryo oxygen, and sauna float.

The owner was so nice and welcoming! She gave us a tour of the facility and was really knowledgeable about all of the amenities, which I really appreciated. Everything felt clean, relaxing, and welcoming from the moment we walked in.

It was such a fun way to spend part of my birthday and get some much-needed relaxation in. I would definitely recommend Zivel for a special occasion, a self-care day, or even just some routine rejuvenation. If you’re in the Atlanta area, definitely consider supporting this small business — we really enjoyed our visit! 🤍✨

I’ve had such a great experience with Zivel Buckhead! From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is welcoming, relaxing, and genuinely focused on helping you feel your best.

What really stands out to me is the people. The team is knowledgeable, friendly, and takes the time to make you feel comfortable and explain the different services without ever making you feel pressured.

I also love the variety of wellness and recovery options available in one place. Whether you’re looking to relax, recover, recharge, or simply take a little better care of yourself, there’s something for you.

If you’ve been curious about Zivel Buckhead, I definitely recommend giving them a try. Great people, great environment, and a wonderful addition to the Buckhead community!

I got a Cryo Facial from April at ZIVEL Performance & Recovery, and it was an amazing experience! I have TMJ, and the cold therapy gave me relief from the daily pain I deal with. April was incredibly knowledgeable, and her consultation was thorough and professional. You can tell she genuinely cares about her clients and loves what she does. The results exceeded my expectations, and I'll definitely be coming back. 10/10 recommend! If you're skeptical, like I was, it worked for me.

I wish I could give them 10 stars! This place is truly wonderful! The service from all the people that work there is outstanding. Everyone has a great and positive attitude. Very professional and friendly! I highly recommend coming here. This will be the best decision of your life.
This place is awesome!! The staff is fantastic! Super clean!

This has been life changing! I came here one week ago in the middle of a Hashimotos flare and Zivel has given me my life back. I lost 7lbs in fluid and feel like I have mental clarity that I have not had in years. My body is not in chronic pain. I will be a lifer
Joined my wife here who was getting another service, so I took advantage of trying their services as well. The staff was welcoming and friendly, and they explained each component of their facility.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Absolutely Exceptional Experience at Zivel Spa!

Zivel is truly a hidden gem and an absolute oasis of relaxation, rejuvenation, and luxury! From the moment you walk through the doors, you are welcomed into a serene, inviting atmosphere that makes you feel instantly relaxed and completely taken care of. Every detail reflects a commitment to excellence, from the beautiful ambiance to the outstanding service and the overall experience.
The staff is warm, professional, attentive, and genuinely passionate about making every visit special. You can feel the difference when a place truly cares about its guests, and Zivel goes above and beyond to create an experience that feels both luxurious and personal. I highly recommend this place. So, if you’re looking for a place that offers  infrared sauna, compression therapy, oxygen bar, Red Light therapy, cryo slimming and toning, body contouring, Dry float,cryolife facial and Cryotherapy this is the place for you! So Whether you’re visiting to unwind, recharge, or simply take some much-needed time for yourself, Zivel delivers an experience that leaves you feeling refreshed, renewed, and pampered. It’s more than just a spa visit; it’s an opportunity to step away from the stresses of everyday life and focus on your well-being. I cannot recommend Zivel highly enough! If you’re looking for a spa that combines exceptional service, a relaxing atmosphere, and an elevated wellness experience, Zivel is absolutely the place to go. I look forward to returning and would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a truly wonderful spa experience. Five stars all the way! ✨

Zivel Wellness is truly my go-to sanctuary for everything from cryotherapy and infrared sauna to red light therapy, cryo slimming, and facials. The owners are incredibly knowledgeable and genuinely passionate about wellness, and you can feel their energy carried throughout the entire space—it creates such a grounded, calming environment. It’s warm, beautifully designed, and instantly relaxing—from the clean, comfortable robes and fresh towels to the thoughtful touches and overall ambiance. Every visit feels like a full reset, not just a treatment! 10/10 highly recommend! .

Such a great experience at Zivel ! I did compression and red light therapy and loved it. Carolina was amazing—so welcoming, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience even better. I left feeling refreshed and ready to go. Definitely coming back!

Absolutely incredible experience at Zivel Wellness Center in Coral Gables! Today was my first visit, and I honestly walked out absolutely mind-blown. I did the infrared sauna and the cryotherapy chamber, and I could genuinely feel the difference afterward—I felt refreshed, recovered, and energized after just one session.

Mike and the entire staff were amazing. The customer service is truly beyond excellent. Everyone was professional, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in.

If you’re looking for a place focused on recovery, wellness, and feeling your absolute best, I highly recommend Zivel Wellness Center. I’m already looking forward to my next visit! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Came to Zivel for cryo and infrared sauna a couple days before my Hyrox. It's couple-owned, and you can tell they really care. The service is cool and super personal. I've done recovery elsewhere, but the equipment here is noticeably better. Felt fresh going into race day. Will definitely be back.

I’ve had a wonderful experience with Zivel and have really enjoyed incorporating their wellness services into my routine. The staff is always welcoming, knowledgeable, and attentive, and the atmosphere makes every visit feel both relaxing and rejuvenating.
I’ve been using several of their services, including Red Light Therapy, Cryotherapy, Infrared Sauna, and Cryoslim, and I appreciate having so many wellness and recovery options available in one place. I especially enjoy how refreshed and energized I feel after my sessions.
What really stands out to me is the overall experience. The team takes the time to explain the services, answer my questions, and make sure I’m comfortable throughout each treatment. The facility is clean, modern, and inviting, which makes it easy to look forward to my appointments.
If you’re interested in adding recovery, relaxation, and wellness treatments to your self-care routine, I definitely recommend giving Zivel a try. I’ve been very pleased with the service and my experience!

I’ve been coming to Zivel Recovery in Cumming since they opened. I initially started with compression and cryotherapy, but these days I primarily use the sauna. It’s become one of my favorite ways to finish a workout.

It’s on the pricier side, but there’s a level of professionalism and attention to detail that sets it apart. When you’re paying for a premium experience, you expect consistency, and they deliver. The sauna towels are always stocked, water bottles are available up front, and the space consistently looks clean and well cared for. Those little things matter, especially when you’re a regular customer.

The biggest plus for me is the convenience. I can book an appointment from my phone while I’m working out and head straight over afterward. It fits seamlessly into my routine without extra planning or hassle.

What keeps me coming back is knowing what to expect every time: a clean, well-maintained space and a professional, relaxing experience. Highly recommend!

Since I rely heavily on customer reviews, I wanted to share my observations and experience with Zivel at Windermere in Cumming.

This family owed and operated business seems to be the first of it's kind in our area.  The facility is clean, beautiful and very private so that guests can relax and enjoy the services that are offered.

I don't have previous experience with cryo, flotation or red light therapy.  The staff provided so much information regarding the benefit of each service in a low pressure, but enthusiastic way.

There is great focus on overall and long term wellness at Zivel  (not just treating achy joints and muscles)  This is a wonderful holistic approach and the owners and staff are committed to the wellness, recovery and comfort of thier guest's experience.

Amazing experience at Zivel! I had a cryogenic session followed up with a warm facial. This place felt like a white glove experience from beginning to end. People were so nice and welcoming. I had a million questions and they were super helpful guiding me through the process. They have many different options. I can’t wait to try them all! The space feels welcoming and very clean. Can’t wait to go back!♥️

Having never been to a facility like this before I wasn’t sure what to expect. Wow was I amazed. First thing I noticed was how clean everything was and how friendly the staff was. Answering every question I asked, and there were many!  I loved the red light therapy and oxygen bar! So relaxing. After getting over being a chicken, I tried cryotherapy.  I’m from upstate NY so I figured I was use to the cold… ummm NO! But the health and recovery benefits are so worth it. And I got to listen to a favorite song. I also had a local cryotherapy on my neck and that relief was felt within the same day! I was there with my father and two nephews. There was plenty for all age groups and various levels of “recovery” needed. I highly recommend giving Zivel a try. You won’t regret it.

| Zivel |

This space has been life-changing for me.
(I keep the drama low-key.)

I have been coming here consistently for 5 months. My experience has been a reduction in pain & inflammation that LASTS.
For days, not hours.

I am almost in disbelief that this is working so well. I have scoliosis, genetic spinal issues, etc.
I highly recommend the Cryo Chamber for anyone experiencing pain & inflammation. In 3 minutes you can effectively reduce inflammation while receiving a boost of dopamine. This helps my brain & body. ❤️ that for me.

The Neveskin Soothe treatments are
a “MUST-TRY” for any inflammation.
…full stop.
I have results that I can SEE & FEEL.

I am so grateful to Faith for reaching out and giving me the opportunity to experience this new technology. I have been making a lot of progress due to her ability to customize the session to fit my specific goals & needs. A lot of doctors & medical professionals have used the words “not possible” when it comes to some of my health challenges. Coming here has been a big game changer. I have been able to be active for more of the day and make progress on my goals.
That’s priceless to me.

Thank you 🙏

Highly impressed with Zivel in Fayetteville!   This is literally a “One stop shop” - Lindsey & Faith were so helpful and informative. ~ Zivel offers cryotherapy, dry float, infrared sauna, red-light, oxygen bar and lymphatic compression and a high powered vibration plate machine! They have different recovery routines at affordable rates!!

Had such a great experience at Zivel Cryo • Red Light • Sauna! I did the 15-minute red light therapy, 10-minute vibration plate, and a 3-minute cryo session for my first time ever. Kelly was so welcoming from the moment I walked in and took the time to explain everything and all the benefits. The whole experience was amazing, and I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend!

Had such a great experience at Zivel  I did the 3-minute cryo chamber session,15-minute red light therapy, cryo slimming PKG for 30 minutes and 10-minute vibration plate, for my first time ever.  Faith was so friendly from the moment I called the first time for information all the way to when I walked in and she took the time to explain everything to me and all the benefits. The whole experience was amazing, and I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend!

Faith was fantastic at explaining everything to me and describing the positive aspects of each of the different modalities offered. She was very understanding of my different physical needs and desires for better health and healing. She was mindful of my comfort and budgetary restraints. I will be back for a membership in July when my budget is better!

ZIVEL👏🏼FIELDHOUSE👏🏼
1000/10 experience!! The staff are so friendly, services are amazing, and the facility is so peaceful!

I started my time with a cryofacial, and let me just tell you GO GET ONE. Lily was incredible and so knowledgeable🙌🏼 after, I took a 30 minute nap on the dry float bed! Best sleep I’ve had in two years IYKYK😅😂

Once I woke up, I went straight to 15 minutes of red light therapy, then my friend Krista met me there to talk and fellowship about life and business while doing an oxygen treatment!!

I finally tried a vibration plate, and am OBSESSED!! I finished off in the massage chair with more oxygen treatments!!

Daughter is a softball/basketball player returning from injury. Long tournament this past weekend and her body was sore.  Crying and compression therapy and she’s feeling tremendously better.  Definitely recommend for athletes looking to recover after competition.

I started going to Zivel in November of 2024 and using cryo therapy, compression, & oxygen and I had so much energy and dropped the last 10 lbs I had been trying to lose!  Then I started cryo slimming and lost almost an inch off my arms in just 2 treatments:) I love it so much! Friendly staff and the owners are knowledgeable and kind. Highly recommend anyone on a wellness journey to visit and try all they have to offer:)

My family went for together for the first time today and it was a great experience from the time we entered to the time we left. Great customer service!! We are in our mid 30s and we are very active and I’m so glad that we ZIVEL. We feel great after leaving. Already working on coming back!!

I used the localized cryo combined with compression and the cryo chamber to help reduce the swelling to a knee injury while playing baseball. In just three. A aaa days, I was able to hit, and back to catching in one week. The results were amazing! Staff is professional and knowledgeable! 100% recommend for injury care!

I started going to Nicole at Zivel for cryofacials/cryoslimming on my neck in preparation for my wedding, and saw great results immediately! Nicole is always kind and friendly, and I always enjoy going and see wonderful results. Very much recommend!

I am new to the area and so happy I found Nicole at Zivel. She is so nice and very knowledgeable on the services they provide there! My skin glows every time I get a treatment done. You will not be disappointed seeing her for any service.

Nicole was amazing. She was super welcoming and sweet. My husband and I did the facial focusing on chin and neck as well as my arms, for my upcoming wedding. After my session looking in the mirror I noticed immediate results and I am so excited to see the results to follow. I totally recommend coming here for rest, relaxation, and a quick glow up. Thank you so much Nicole! ✨

Zivel has truly captured “wellness” at their Cool Springs clinic. From the Oxygen bar in the waiting room, to the plush changing robes between sauna/cryo sessions. I left feeling totally energized and ready for the day. Thank you Zivel!

Zivel Performance & Recovery is truly a game-changer! They offer state-of-the-art recovery services that go far beyond your typical wellness center. The staff is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, making every visit feel comfortable and welcoming. I signed up while training for a half marathon, and it’s been one of the best decisions I’ve made—my body feels absolutely amazing after each visit.  Not only has it helped with recovery, but I also feel more confident staying injury-free throughout my training. Highly recommend!

Melanie Ann

I had a great experience at Zivel Highlands Ranch! I tried the cryo chamber, float bed, and a cryo facial with Jen, and loved every minute. The atmosphere is so relaxing! I even fell asleep during the float bed! Jen did an amazing job on my facial, and my skin felt so refreshed afterward. The location is super convenient, and I’ve already recommended Zivel to my friends and family. I even booked a session for my mom this week. Highly recommend!

Zivel Performance & Recovery is absolutely amazing. The floating bed is such a cool and unique experience for recovery, and I love that they offer everything in one place — sauna, cryo, Normatec boots, and more. It truly feels like a one-stop shop for everything you need to stay healthy, recover better, and feel your best.

The space is very well decorated, super clean, and the staff is great. On top of that, the pricing is very affordable for everything they offer.

I tried it once and became a member on the spot. I strongly recommend Zivel to anyone looking to improve recovery, health, and overall wellness. I would give 10 stars if I could!

I always enjoy receiving treatments from Lee. From the moment you arrive, she makes you feel comfortable and cared for. She truly takes the time to listen to your wants and concerns, and she customizes each treatment so it feels personal and thoughtful. Her touch is intentional, gentle, and calming, and you can tell she puts her whole heart into her work. I always leave feeling relaxed, refreshed, and glowing. I know my skin is in the very best hands with her. I highly recommend Lee!

I had a facial done with Lee, she did absolutely amazing! As my skin is already very sensitive and dry all the time she made my skin feel like a baby’s butt for a week! Totally recommend Lee for your next service🤎

Lee at Zivel Highlands Ranch is amazing! She’s incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and truly cares about helping people feel their best. The space is clean and welcoming, and every service from Facials, Microneedling, Dermaplaning and Infrared Sauna to Float and Compression are intentional and effective.

I’ve noticed my skin looking revitalized and body has reduced soreness, better recovery, and an overall sense of rejuvenation. If you’re in Highlands Ranch or nearby, I highly recommend seeing Lee!!

Dear Zivel,
What an amazing experience! As a first-time visitor, I was truly impressed by how beautiful, clean, and inviting your facility is. Carolina was incredibly helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable about all the amenities, which made my visit even better.

I’m grateful for the opportunity to experience this space, and I will definitely be sharing it with my friends and family. The environment felt peaceful, sacred, and truly special.

Thank you so much.

I wasn’t sure what to expect when I walked Into Zivel. I absolutely loved the concept, especially because I don’t like to sit still. So everything in there is three minutes in the cold room, which is my favorite all-time favorite room. Especially because you can dance in there oh my God I love that. And then I floated and relaxed for 20 minutes and then I did the infrared for 10 minutes and then I did Isomething that squeezed my hips and my thighs so much that I loved it. You have to go and try it. It’s my new go to.  The staff is amazing. The rooms  are super clean and you just feel very comfortable and you walk out of their feeling at least 10 years younger.

I went in for a wellness day and ended up trying almost everything—cryotherapy, red light therapy, lymphatic drainage, sauna, and the dry float. Honestly, I loved it all. The space feels super chill and clean, and the staff is really friendly and helpful. I left feeling totally relaxed and recharged. Definitely coming back soon!

I’ve been truly impressed with Zivel Hollywood. On my very first visit I arrived with my lip very swollen because I had accidentally bitten it earlier that day. Without really knowing, I went into the Red Light Therapy just because I wanted to try all the services, and I walked out with the swelling almost completely gone. From the moment I started the session I could feel improvement, and about 15 minutes later the result was honestly amazing. After that I did cryotherapy 2 mins and it finished reducing the inflammation even more. From that day on, Zivel Hollywood became part of my routine.
I also love the compression therapy, I play tennis and it really helps my recovery. The dry float helps me rest, relax and lower my stress levels. I honestly can’t pick a favorite because I enjoy every service.
I’m also excited to try the cryo facials since I see everyone loves them, and I’ll definitely share another review after, but so far I absolutely love my experience!

I joined for cryotherapy & also use Red light therapy & compression several times a week. My left hip pain is gone & my skin looks amazing. You will feel results quickly if you go consistently. The owner & staff are amazing 🤩I highly recommend this to everyone. Restorative practices are critical to ones overall health & well being.

I was intrigued most by the dry float here.. it was definitely interesting to say the least. It took me into a trance and deep meditative sleep, when I woke up my entire body, mind, and emotional state was at peace. I definitely will go back for that alone.

They have red light therapy and infrared saunas too, I’m not a huge fan of their red light therapy set up because it’s more like a tanning bed, but other than that. I see myself going back to decompress in the dry float on the days I really need it.

If you’re thinking about going to Zivel, you must try it out! I’m so happy I came across this awesome place! I met one of the owners, Chris, and he’s super nice but everyone that works here is also really friendly and they keep everything very clean as well! I love how all the sessions are private and you don’t have to share a room with anyone like some other places. All of their recovery sessions are great especially the infrared sauna and you can choose the lighting that you want or you can change the colors which I think gives a more relaxing experience. I’ve been coming to Zivel for the past few months right before their grand opening and the red light therapy, float therapy, and cryotherapy, etc. really does work so I’ll definitely be continuing my membership! Give it a shot and you won’t regret it!

The facilities are really nice and the services they offer are all very beneficial! I did the compression sleeves and they made my legs feel brand new. Also did the cryotherapy which  was an amazing experience! Highly recommend this place if you take your performance and recovery seriously.

Had a really positive visit at Zivel Metairie. Clean, modern facility with friendly and professional staff who explain everything clearly. Tried a few therapies and felt real benefits, relaxing and effective. Definitely recommend and will be coming back.

Had a great day at Zivel! First we were greeted by Chris, he is so sweet. He showed us all the modalities we were going to experience. My favorite was the dry float bed. I felt like I slept for a week. Zivel is a great way to relax after a busy holiday season
Been getting some great results here. Staff is great and very accommodating. Very reasonably priced also compared to other places with similar services in town. Give them a try!

This was such a lovely experience. I did the dry float, the compression with oxygen, the sauna and the cryotherapy. It was my favorite day ever. I will be back! Thank you Zivel for showing me a wonderful experience at your spa!

For anyone who has inflammation, who is an athlete, or just wants to relax, they have tools that will give you some relaxation and relief. Give Zivel a try… you won’t regret it. The guy in my pic is Scott Hayes. He owns the franchise and is a great guy!

Love this place! So glad we have one in Murfreesboro.  From the Infrared Sauna to compression  and oxygen to Cryo, this place has it all. Definitely recommend checking this place out  whether you are looking for a good recovery routine after your workout or even just some relaxation. The sauna is my favorite! Love hooking up my music via Bluetooth and just sweating out the stresses
of the week. Feels like a dance party! 10/10💪🏼

Scott and Luke are absolutely great! Amazing customer service! Loved the whole experience! I was able to try each service and I was truly amazed. I’m no athlete but I am a mother with a new baby and I am a full time server and let me tell you… it was amazing for my mental and physical health, I can’t imagine how much it would be helpful for an athlete or someone who works out! 💪🏽 the environment was relaxing and very clean!

I am hesitant to tell people about this place because I enjoy scheduling recovery services whenever I get some free time and more people joining means less availability. With that being said, this company deserves the recognition despite my own selfishness. The staff is beyond friendly, the app is easy to use, and the owners really do care about their clients health and wellness. I am a powerlifter so I am constantly putting a lot of strain on my joints and muscles. Zivel helps me recover from the toll I put my body through and as a bonus its covered through my HSA. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who is struggling with pain/inflammation to give it a try.

I had a wonderful time! Avery was so accommodating considering I was a last minute walk-in. The red light therapy bed felt great! The storefront is adorable and has wonderful uplifting messages throughout.

I got a membership before they opened, and I couldn’t be happier with that decision. Zivel is a great place for quality recovery. The staff is all incredibly nice and attentive. The facility is SPOTLESS at all times. My favorite is doing the infared sauna followed by the cryo booth - I always feel energized and refreshed after. My daughter also has a membership to aid in her recovery from soccer. She loves the leg compression and float tank! 10/10 would recommend!

5-Star Review: Zivel in Parker is Pure Heaven for Recovery and Rejuvenation!

I recently signed up for the monthly subscription at Zivel in Parker, and wow—what an incredible introduction to next-level wellness! The package includes cryotherapy, infrared sauna, red light therapy, compression and oxygen therapy.  There are also some premium services cyro slimming, toning and facial for an additional nominal fee!  It's already become my go-to for feeling refreshed and youthful.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by two amazing young ladies—M.E. and Paige (I believe those were their names). They were incredibly helpful, pleasant, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience so welcoming and fun. They guided me through nearly everything on offer, and I left feeling like a new person!

I started with the Cryolift facial—about 45 minutes of soothing cold therapy that left my skin glowing and, honestly, I swear it took 20 years off my wrinkles! Then came 15 minutes in the infrared sauna—pure bliss for these aching bones; it warmed me up and melted away tension like nothing else.

Next, M.E. got me into the cryo chamber for a quick 3-minute session at -151 degrees. I walked out feeling completely rejuvenated, energized, and youthful—truly amazing!
After that, 30 minutes of compression therapy on both legs—it circulated my blood and lymphatic system so effectively that my legs felt like they belonged to my 20-year-old self again. No more heaviness or soreness!

I followed up with 15 minutes of red light therapy, which I know works best with consistency, so I'm committing to 3–4 sessions a week moving forward. The benefits for skin, recovery, and circulation are already noticeable.

To cap it all off, I ended with float therapy in their dry float bed—warm water, a heavy blanket, eye mask, and soothing music for 30 minutes. I fell asleep in about 5 minutes and woke up feeling like I'd had the best rest of my life. Incredible!

Overall, Zivel Parker delivers an exceptional, luxurious experience in a clean, modern space with top-tier equipment and genuinely caring staff. If you're looking to recover faster, reduce pain and inflammation, boost your energy, or just treat yourself to some serious self-care, this place is a piece of heaven. Highly recommend carving out time in your day to try it—you won't regret it!

More updates to come as I keep going back. Thank you, Zivel team—you're changing lives one session at a time!
